# Property PaperSources

#### PaperSources

Gets the names of the available paper sources for the current printer.

##### Declaration

```
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
List<string> PaperSources { get; }
```

##### Property Value

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  List<string> |   |  

##### Remarks

This property is available since v7.6.
